text:
jenn-cs: ArcadiaXR onboarding demo tomorrow 14:00 UTC. They need a short-lived allowlist + rate bump for ap-southeast-1 edge to run a partner pilot. Renewal flagged if demo doesn't go well — wants low friction. Can someone provision a temp window and QPS increase? Customer says they will provide CIDRs and a header.

omar-se: Got CIDR and header from Kate (customer). CIDR: 52.76.34.0/24, header: x-api-client: arcadiaxr-demo. They asked for region ap-southeast-1 with fallback to us-east if we hit capacity. Asked for 72h window. CC @mike-am for renewal context.

lina-platform: I can apply the allowlist + rate window. Proposing: 250 QPS steady, 2k burst, duration 72h (auto-revoke). Will tag change as cs-temp-bump/arcadiaxr and add ticket before applying. Quick question: do we want to disable prefix caching for the demo to avoid stale outputs?

ryan-sre: 250 QPS OK on edge pool. Add token-level cap to prevent key sharing — suggest token max 100 req/s. Also put fallback policy to a quantized model variant at 95% capacity to preserve latency SLO. I'll review changes and approve apply.

jenn-cs: Please notify Kate (kate@arcadiaxr.com) when it's live. She also asked about a Dedicated quote — renewal risk note: medium-high. I'll open a renewal ops task separately.

lina-platform: Config snippet I'll apply (ticket CS-8741):
```yaml
customer: ArcadiaXR
region: ap-southeast-1
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 52.76.34.0/24
headers_allowed:
  - name: x-api-client
    value: arcadiaxr-demo
qps: 250
burst: 2000
token_level_limit: 100
auto_revoke: 2026-03-27T13:30:00Z
tag: cs-temp-bump/arcadiaxr
fallback_policy:
  threshold: 0.95
  model_variant: small-quantized-v1
notes: "disable_prefix_cache: true (for demo)"
```

deploy-bot: Config change queued: job id #cfg-8821. apply-at 2026-03-24T13:40:00Z.

ryan-sre: Applied in staging, smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in ~5m and will monitor latency/error trends. Will post to #eng-oncall if >5% 5xx or latency P95 > 600ms.

lina-platform: Done — allowlist + rate bump applied to ap-southeast-1. Autorevoke scheduled for 2026-03-27T13:30:00Z. Ticket CS-8741 updated with job id #cfg-8821 and tags. Post-demo action: collect prompt/response samples and run quality eval for regressions.

jenn-cs: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll notify Kate and the AM. Scheduling a post-demo sync to capture feedback and escalation plan if the demo surfaces issues.

mike-am: Noted — please log ARR & renewal window in Salesforce and flag for potential Dedicated conversation. If they ask, we'll need to prepare a capacity/price estimate.
